resources.string: Draws the edge glow over your apps and the lock screen, without Android\'s \"displaying over other apps\" notification. Rimlit only uses this to show its glow window: it receives no accessibility events and cannot read or control anything on your screen.
Glow the screen edges when a notification arrives
Lets Rimlit detect notifications from other apps.
Lets Rimlit glow while the screen is on.
Lets Rimlit post the silent notification that wakes the screen into the glow. Keep Rimlit\'s notifications and its \"Edge lighting\" category on, at high importance.
Lets Rimlit wake the screen to glow while it is off. Android 14 and newer hide this behind a separate grant.

Lets Rimlit glow above the lock screen too, and without Android\'s \"displaying over other apps\" notification. Turn on \"%1$s\" in Accessibility settings; on Android 13 and newer, sideloaded apps may first need \"Allow restricted settings\" from Rimlit\'s App info menu.
Recommended so the glow is not delayed by battery optimization.
On-screen glows are drawn over other apps, so Android shows \"Rimlit is displaying over other apps\" while one is up. Turn on \"%1$s\" in Accessibility settings to avoid it.
\"%1$s\" is on in Accessibility settings but isn\'t running, so on-screen glows are drawn over other apps and Android shows its notice. Turn it off and on again.
Rimlit needs \"%1$s\" or Display over other apps to glow while the screen is on. Turn on \"%1$s\" in Accessibility settings.
Android will show \"Rimlit is displaying over other apps\" until \"%1$s\" is turned on in Accessibility settings.
Android will show \"Rimlit is displaying over other apps\": \"%1$s\" is on but isn\'t running. Turn it off and on again in Accessibility settings.
This preview can\'t show until \"%1$s\" is turned on in Accessibility settings, or Display over other apps is allowed.

Rimlit lights up the screen border whenever any app posts a notification. With the screen off it wakes into a black, always-on-display style glow; while the screen is on it draws an overlay, including above the lock screen when the accessibility glow is on. Some OEMs (Xiaomi, Huawei, OnePlus) additionally require enabling autostart in their own battery settings.
